items.prompt:
An event that pushes the plot forward is said to:
A) propel the action
B) end the book
C) change the title

Dialogue can REVEAL:
A) a character's true nature
B) the page count
C) the font

A sudden, urgent event can:
A) provoke a decision
B) have no effect
C) only change the setting

steps: Forces a choice. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

'If you walk out that door, don't come back.' Mara picked up her bag and left.

The father's line mainly:
A) propels the action by forcing Mara's departure
B) ends the story
C) describes the weather
items.answer: A) propels the action by forcing Mara's departure

steps: Drives the plot. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) propels the action by forcing Mara's departure

items.prompt:
Read.

When the thief quietly returned the stolen wallet, we saw a side of him no one expected.

This incident mainly:
A) reveals an unexpected, honest side of his character
B) changes the setting
C) has no purpose
items.answer: A) reveals an unexpected, honest side of his character

solution.answer: A) reveals an unexpected, honest side of his character

items.prompt:
Read.

Seeing the flood swallow the bridge, Captain Reyes ordered the evacuation.

The incident:
A) provokes his decision to evacuate
B) ends the plot
C) reveals nothing
items.answer: A) provokes his decision to evacuate

steps: Forces a decision. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) provokes his decision to evacuate

items.prompt:
Read.

At the trial, the quiet clerk suddenly stood and admitted he had seen the real culprit. The courtroom erupted, and the judge halted the sentencing.

The clerk's dialogue does ALL of the following EXCEPT:
A) reveal his courage and honesty
B) propel the action (halting the sentencing)
C) describe the courtroom's architecture

steps: It reveals character and drives plot, not scenery. Key is C.

items.prompt:
Why do authors use pivotal lines of dialogue and incidents?
A) to propel the plot, reveal character, or force decisions
B) to pad the page count
C) to confuse the reader
items.answer: A) to propel the plot, reveal character, or force decisions

solution.answer: A) to propel the plot, reveal character, or force decisions
